questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this adapter handles failures when talking to the device cloud? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A caller iterates client.readings(...) and the third page fails with 503 on all four attempts. What does the caller observe?
choices: All readings from every page, with the third page silently missing.
The readings from the first two pages, followed by a TransientProviderError raised from the iteration.
Nothing: the generator fetches every page before yielding the first reading.
An empty result, because the failure discards the earlier pages.

questions.prompt: A temperature reading arrives with unit "R". What happens?
choices: It is converted as if it were Celsius.
It is skipped and logged, and iteration continues.
The page request is retried up to four times.
UnsupportedUnit propagates out of the generator at that reading.

questions.prompt: The device cloud answers 404 to a command for a decommissioned device. What does send_command do?
choices: Raises DeviceNotFound at once, because the retry policy only covers timeouts, network errors and TransientProviderError.
Retries four times with backoff, because every 4xx is retried.
Returns None after logging the status.
Raises TransientProviderError, because 404 is treated like 503.
